latestVersion.changelog:
Video Generator Free Simple — Initial Release

- Generate videos from text or images without editing software, supporting MP4, JPG, PNG, and MOV files up to 200MB.
- Fast cloud-based processing using GPUs delivers ready-to-share 1080p MP4 videos in about 30-60 seconds.
- Automatic free session setup with 100 credits; no installation required.
- Handles uploads, text/image input, video generation, export, credits, and session state via intuitive chat prompts.
- Provides simple workflows for quick video creation, batch edits, and timeline refinement.
